result.instructions: Tools for Breathe HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Breathe HR data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run breathehr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run breathehr_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run breathehr_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. breathehr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: breathehr_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Breathe HR account (company) this API key belongs to: id, name, domain and enabled modules. GET /account.

tools.name: breathehr_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments (id, name). Use the ids to filter absences, leave, sickness and pay. GET /departments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_divisions
tools.title: List divisions
tools.description: List the company's divisions (id, name). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /divisions.

tools.name: breathehr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the company's work locations (id, name). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /locations.

tools.name: breathehr_list_working_patterns
tools.title: List working patterns
tools.description: List the working patterns (hours per weekday, total weekly hours, default flag). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /working_patterns.

tools.name: breathehr_list_holiday_allowances
tools.title: List holiday allowances
tools.description: List the holiday allowance schemes (id, default flag, year_1 to year_10 = the allowance for each year of service, created_at, updated_at). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /holiday_allowances.

tools.name: breathehr_list_other_leave_reasons
tools.title: List other leave reasons
tools.description: List the reasons for non-holiday leave (e.g. compassionate, jury service). Use the ids to filter absences. All of them are returned in one reply. GET /other_leave_reasons.

tools.name: breathehr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with job title, department, division, location, line manager, holiday approver, working pattern, join/leaving dates and status. Bank details and National Insurance numbers are never returned. GET /employees.

filter.description: Only employees with this role: hr (HR managers), line_manager, either, or neither.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee's record by id (personal and job details, contacts, manager, working pattern). Bank details and NI number are never returned. GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: breathehr_get_holiday_years
tools.title: Get holiday years (allowance balance)
tools.description: An employee's holiday years: start/end, allowance, days or hours taken, booked and remaining. Pass for_date to get only the year that contains that date. GET /employees/{id}/employee_holiday_years.

for_date.description: Only the holiday year that includes this date (yyyy-mm-dd), e.g. today.

tools.name: breathehr_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List approved absences (holiday and other leave) with employee, dates, half days, days deducted and cancelled flag. Filter by employee, department, type, other-leave reason and dates. GET /absences.

department_id.description: Only absences of employees in this department.

other_leave_reason_id.description: Only other leave with this reason (ids from breathehr_list_other_leave_reasons).

start_date.description: Only absences on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Only absences up to this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests (pending, approved, rejected and cancelling requests) with employee, dates, half days, type, status and notes. Filter by employee, department and start-date range. GET /leave_requests.

department_id.description: Only requests of employees in this department.

start_date.description: Only requests starting on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Only requests starting on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: One leave request by id, with its status. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: breathehr_list_sicknesses
tools.title: List sickness records
tools.description: List sickness absence records (health data): employee, sickness type, dates, half days, days deducted, status (open, returned, closed…) and reason. Filter by employee, department and start-date range. GET /sicknesses.

department_id.description: Only sickness of employees in this department.

start_date.description: Only sickness starting on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Only sickness starting on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_salaries
tools.title: List salaries
tools.description: List salary records (amount, basis, payment schedule, start date) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /salaries, /employees/{id}/salaries or /departments/{id}/salaries.

department_id.description: Only records of employees in this department.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_bonuses
tools.title: List bonuses
tools.description: List bonus records (amount, date, description) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /bonuses, /employees/{id}/bonuses or /departments/{id}/bonuses.

department_id.description: Only records of employees in this department.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_benefits
tools.title: List benefits
tools.description: List employee benefits (type, value, start/end) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /benefits, /employees/{id}/benefits or /departments/{id}/benefits.

department_id.description: Only records of employees in this department.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_employee_jobs
tools.title: List employee jobs
tools.description: List job history records (job title, start/end dates, department, location) for all employees or one employee. GET /employee_jobs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_training_courses
tools.title: List training courses
tools.description: List employee training records (course name, type, status, dates, cost) for all employees or one employee. GET /employee_training_courses.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_expense_claims
tools.title: List expense claims
tools.description: List expense claims (employee, total, state, approver) filtered by employee and state. GET /employee_expense_claims.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List individual expense items (date, description, type, amount, VAT, project). By default only unclaimed items; set include_claimed to see all. GET /employee_expenses.

include_claimed.description: Also return expenses already part of a claim.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_list_change_requests
tools.title: List change requests
tools.description: List employee self-service change requests (field, requested value, approval state) for all employees or one employee. Requested values of bank and NI fields are redacted. GET /change_requests or /employees/{id}/change_requests.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: breathehr_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create leave request
tools.description: WRITE: request leave for an employee (holiday by default, or other leave). It is created as a request, then follows the account's approval rules; the employee's approver is notified. Each call creates a new request. POST /employees/{id}/leave_requests.

end_date.description: Last day of leave (yyyy-mm-dd), same as start_date for one day.

half_start.description: The first day is a half day (default false).

half_start_am_pm.description: Which half of the first day: am or pm (with half_start).

half_end.description: The last day is a half day (default false).

half_end_am_pm.description: Which half of the last day: am or pm (with half_end).

tools.name: breathehr_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending leave request; it becomes an absence and is deducted from the allowance. Recorded as done by the "API Employee". POST /leave_requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: breathehr_reject_leave_request
tools.title: Reject leave request
tools.description: WRITE: reject a pending leave request with a reason the employee will see. Recorded as done by the "API Employee". POST /leave_requests/{id}/reject.

rejection_reason.description: Why the request is rejected (shown to the employee).
